name: Globed Mobile Voice Chat
description: adds a talk button for Globed voice chat on Android or ioS though it needs a build of globed with mobile voice sending enabled, on normal geode Globed the button will appear but womt send audio.

enabled.name: Enable Button
enabled.description: Show the push-to-talk button while connected to a Globed session. Turn off to hide it completely.

edit-position.name: Move Button
edit-position.description: When ts on, you can drag the talk button anywhere on screen, turn it back off to lock it in place and be able to use it normally.

button-opacity.name: Button Opacity
button-opacity.description: How transparent the talk button is.

button-scale.name: Button Size
button-scale.description: How large the  talk button is.

button-preview.name: Preview
button-preview.description: preview of the buttons current size and opacity.
